scope: Close six stale structure findings against current source and review seven additional symbolic/shortcut label cases. Three metadata repairs preserve the complete original models and artwork. This is not full-catalog WCAG, speech-recognition, audio-synthesis or performance acceptance.

changes.change: Native action button uses its exact current Firm snap/Gentle snap caption and next-mode instruction. Original model and both snapping behaviors are unchanged.
Full key names include each printed shortcut and original note name. The full Mute toggle name remains stable; visible captions and pressed state remain unchanged.

Full toggle identity includes object name, Return and object number without changing across painted faces or pin states. Existing descriptions still expose the painted note and accurate pin/Escape instructions.

staleStructureReview.actualGroupAndGridChecks: Supported named groups are exposed in both engines. The city remains one named image containing ninety original parcels; nested graphical groups have supported DOM roles. Native Scheduler exposes a launcher without grid-only attributes until activation, then an owned forty-cell/eight-row window. Complete full grid remains 336 cells in 48 rows.

names.scope: Initial and deliberate reduced-motion full-view states of 29 retained label/name findings, plus focused normal-motion Flip Grid/Orbit states, in both Stage themes and desktop/compact widths. Compares explicitly reviewed primary labels with actual Chrome accessibility names, retaining original raw axe findings separately. Symbolic fields receive descriptive-name checks. This does not establish speech-recognition behavior, all intermediate motion frames, all catalog accessibility or native thumbnail acceptance. Audio output is disabled in these naming contexts; synthesis is covered separately.

structureBrowsers.scope: Actual Chromium accessibility-tree ownership, component-local landmarks, complete structured records, keyboard control stories and 66 fresh network-blocked exports. Does not establish complete WCAG, manual contrast, screen-reader output or final motion/performance conformance.

Actual Chromium accessibility-tree ownership, component-local landmarks, complete structured records, keyboard control stories and 66 fresh network-blocked exports. Does not establish complete WCAG, manual contrast, screen-reader output or final motion/performance conformance.

nativeComparisons.scope: Independent original/current paused native definitions. Exact geometry, DOM, computed styles and PNG bytes after a priming readback. GPU disabled for CSS/pixel comparison only; not default-GPU or timing acceptance.

symbolicAudit.scope: Initial rendered component and shared Dock only; current Stage styles. Does not establish keyboard/touch behavior, screen-reader quality, focus clipping, photographic contrast, hidden states or motion/performance acceptance.

standards.decision: Inference: cycling two active snapping behaviors with a changing caption is represented as an ordinary button, preserving the original behaviors.
Use stable names for the retained full card/Mute toggle states; keep their actual pressed state and current descriptions.
Check literal shortcut letters as complete tokens; review symbolic marks and supporting value text separately.
